unskilled.oewn-02236080-a.label: neutral

family.axis: no skill called for or shown → incapacity worth condemning

unskilled.oewn-02236080-a.tone: Classifying rather than condemning - it covers work that asks for no special skill just as evenly as a hand that has none, where *botchy* is already a verdict on the result.

artless.oewn-02236646-s.label: negative

family.axis: no skill called for or shown → incapacity worth condemning

artless.oewn-02236646-s.tone: Names an absence rather than a mess - what is made shows no art in it, which is a thinner charge than the spoilage *botched* points at.

botchy.oewn-02236745-s.label: negative

family.axis: no skill called for or shown → incapacity worth condemning

botchy.oewn-02236745-s.tone: Dismissive and slightly contemptuous - the badness is lumpy and visible, something you can see in the thing itself.

butcherly.oewn-02236745-s.label: negative

family.axis: no skill called for or shown → incapacity worth condemning

butcherly.oewn-02236745-s.tone: The most violent way to call work bad - it makes the poor doing sound like hacking, where *botchy* only makes it look untidy.

butcherly.oewn-00249970-s.label: negative

family.axis: blood merely present → appetite for killing

butcherly.oewn-00249970-s.tone: Puts a butcher's hand on the bloodshed - crude and workmanlike, contemptuous of the doer where *slaughterous* is merely grand.

unskillful.oewn-02236745-s.label: negative

family.axis: no skill called for or shown → incapacity worth condemning

unskillful.oewn-02236745-s.tone: The flat, unloaded member of its set - it states that the doing fell short of skill and stops, supplying none of the disgust in *butcherly*.

bungled.oewn-02236946-s.label: negative

family.axis: no skill called for or shown → incapacity worth condemning

bungled.oewn-02236946-s.tone: Settles the failure as done and irreversible - the thing was spoiled in the handling and now stands spoiled.

botched.oewn-02236946-s.label: negative

family.axis: no skill called for or shown → incapacity worth condemning

botched.oewn-02236946-s.tone: Coarser than *bungled* - the spoiling is crude and shows, a wreck left behind rather than a slip.

bungling.oewn-02237069-s.label: negative

family.axis: no skill called for or shown → incapacity worth condemning

bungling.oewn-02237069-s.tone: Turns the ineptitude into a standing quality - not one attempt gone wrong but the manner of the doer.

clumsy.oewn-02237069-s.label: negative

family.axis: no skill called for or shown → incapacity worth condemning

clumsy.oewn-02237069-s.tone: The gentlest of its set and the most forgivable - it faults the handling while *incompetent* faults the capacity.

fumbling.oewn-02237069-s.label: negative

family.axis: no skill called for or shown → incapacity worth condemning

fumbling.oewn-02237069-s.tone: Catches the lack of skill in motion - hands groping and losing hold, rather than the finished judgement *incompetent* delivers.

incompetent.oewn-02237069-s.label: negative

family.axis: no skill called for or shown → incapacity worth condemning

incompetent.oewn-02237069-s.tone: The formal verdict of the family - it withholds the aptitude altogether, where *clumsy* grants it and blames only the execution.

crude.oewn-02237329-s.label: negative

family.axis: no skill called for or shown → incapacity worth condemning

crude.oewn-02237329-s.tone: Faults the making as unrefined and hastily finished, an aesthetic complaint rather than the flat incapacity of *incompetent*.

rough.oewn-02237329-s.label: negative

family.axis: no skill called for or shown → incapacity worth condemning

rough.oewn-02237329-s.tone: The mildest complaint available about workmanship - it concedes the care was not taken while leaving *crude* to sound the note of coarseness.

hopeless.oewn-02237557-s.label: negative

family.axis: no skill called for or shown → incapacity worth condemning

hopeless.oewn-02237557-s.tone: Aimed at the person and not the product, it writes off the ability rather than the attempt, with an exasperation that can shade into fondness.

unnoticed.oewn-01612846-a.label: neutral

family.axis: bare absence of notice → attention withheld from something with a claim on it

unnoticed.oewn-01612846-a.tone: The flat baseline of the family - it records only that notice did not happen, imputing no fault to anyone and no claim on attention to the thing itself.

disregarded.oewn-01613047-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare absence of notice → attention withheld from something with a claim on it

disregarded.oewn-01613047-s.tone: In this sense the passing-over is accidental, so the word marks a lapse rather than a snub.

forgotten.oewn-01613047-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare absence of notice → attention withheld from something with a claim on it

forgotten.oewn-01613047-s.tone: The same inadvertent lapse as *disregarded*, but it implies the thing once held attention and lost it, which leaves a faint diminishment on it.

ignored.oewn-01613238-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare absence of notice → attention withheld from something with a claim on it

ignored.oewn-01613238-s.tone: The one where withholding attention reads as chosen - a snub rather than an oversight, and the sting sits in that choice.

neglected.oewn-01613238-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare absence of notice → attention withheld from something with a claim on it

neglected.oewn-01613238-s.tone: Puts the weight on attention that was owed and not paid, so it carries a sense of duty unmet that *ignored* does not.

unheeded.oewn-01613238-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare absence of notice → attention withheld from something with a claim on it

unheeded.oewn-01613238-s.tone: The mildest of the three: it grants that something stood there to be attended to, without *ignored*'s deliberateness or *neglected*'s failure of care.

overlooked.oewn-01613430-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare absence of notice → attention withheld from something with a claim on it

overlooked.oewn-01613430-s.tone: A miss rather than a refusal - it concedes that the thing should have entered the reckoning and quietly admits the error.

unmarked.oewn-01613430-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare absence of notice → attention withheld from something with a claim on it

unmarked.oewn-01613430-s.tone: Flat where *overlooked* is apologetic: it says only that nothing was made of the thing, conceding no mistake.

unnoted.oewn-01613430-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare absence of notice → attention withheld from something with a claim on it

unnoted.oewn-01613430-s.tone: The barest of the three - the plain negative of taking something into account, with no suggestion that anyone should have.

unobserved.oewn-01613579-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare absence of notice → attention withheld from something with a claim on it

unobserved.oewn-01613579-s.tone: Carries the shadow of someone who might have noticed, so it can be a relief as easily as a slight.

unseen.oewn-01613579-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare absence of notice → attention withheld from something with a claim on it

unseen.oewn-01613579-s.tone: Flatly sensory beside *unobserved* - nothing registered, with no watcher implied for the thing to have escaped.

unperceived.oewn-01613725-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare absence of notice → attention withheld from something with a claim on it

unperceived.oewn-01613725-s.tone: Formal and abstract, covering both the failure to register a thing and the silence that follows, with its weight on the registering.

unremarked.oewn-01613725-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare absence of notice → attention withheld from something with a claim on it

unremarked.oewn-01613725-s.tone: Holds the same pair tipped the other way - the thing may well have been seen, and the point is that nothing was said of it.

unoriginal.oewn-01692724-a.label: negative

family.axis: staleness held in contempt → plain absence of freshness

unoriginal.oewn-01692724-a.tone: The flat statement of the fault - nothing fresh in the thing and nothing fresh coming out of it - delivered without the scorn *trite* carries.

banal.oewn-01693210-s.label: negative

family.axis: staleness held in contempt → plain absence of freshness

banal.oewn-01693210-s.tone: Dismissal rather than description: the repetition has emptied the thing out, where *commonplace* only notes that it has been met before.

commonplace.oewn-01693210-s.label: negative

family.axis: staleness held in contempt → plain absence of freshness

commonplace.oewn-01693210-s.tone: Puts the fault in ordinariness rather than in damage - the thing is met everywhere rather than worn thin, which is what *threadbare* and *shopworn* make of the same overuse.

hackneyed.oewn-01693210-s.label: negative

family.axis: staleness held in contempt → plain absence of freshness

hackneyed.oewn-01693210-s.tone: A formal-sounding verdict that the thing has been run into the ground, heavier and more deliberate than *tired*.

old-hat.oewn-01693210-s.label: negative

family.axis: staleness held in contempt → plain absence of freshness

old-hat.oewn-01693210-s.tone: Informal and offhand: it shrugs at how familiar the thing has become instead of condemning it the way *banal* does.

shopworn.oewn-01693210-s.label: negative

family.axis: staleness held in contempt → plain absence of freshness

shopworn.oewn-01693210-s.tone: The overuse leaves a mark, as though the thing had been handled until the shine came off it - grubbier than *well-worn*.

stock.oewn-01693210-s.label: negative

family.axis: staleness held in contempt → plain absence of freshness

stock.oewn-01693210-s.tone: The flattest word here - it files the endless repetition almost as a category rather than a fault, with none of the disgust in *trite*.

threadbare.oewn-01693210-s.label: negative

family.axis: staleness held in contempt → plain absence of freshness

threadbare.oewn-01693210-s.tone: The wear has gone all the way through: the thing still holds its shape but has nothing left in it, harsher than *well-worn*.

timeworn.oewn-01693210-s.label: negative

family.axis: staleness held in contempt → plain absence of freshness

timeworn.oewn-01693210-s.tone: Lays the wearing at time's door rather than at any user's: the overuse registers as accumulated age, not as the running-into-the-ground that *hackneyed* convicts someone of.

tired.oewn-01693210-s.label: negative

family.axis: staleness held in contempt → plain absence of freshness

tired.oewn-01693210-s.tone: Blunt and plain: the thing has simply gone slack from repetition, a flatter judgement than the arch *bromidic*.

trite.oewn-01693210-s.label: negative

family.axis: staleness held in contempt → plain absence of freshness

trite.oewn-01693210-s.tone: The hardest word in the family - it does not merely note the overuse, it writes the thing off as worthless for it.

well-worn.oewn-01693210-s.label: negative

family.axis: staleness held in contempt → plain absence of freshness

well-worn.oewn-01693210-s.tone: Convicts the thing of mileage rather than damage - it has been taken up so many times that nothing in it can still surprise - a lighter charge than the ruin *threadbare* finds or the grubbiness *shopworn* sees.

bromidic.oewn-01693676-s.label: negative

family.axis: staleness held in contempt → plain absence of freshness

bromidic.oewn-01693676-s.tone: Keeps a straight face while it convicts - dull, wearying and puffed up with significance, all named at once, where *corny* simply laughs.

corny.oewn-01693676-s.label: negative

family.axis: staleness held in contempt → plain absence of freshness

corny.oewn-01693676-s.tone: Informal and mocking: both the dullness and the airs come off as laughable, lighter on its feet than *platitudinous*.

platitudinal.oewn-01693676-s.label: negative

family.axis: staleness held in contempt → plain absence of freshness

platitudinal.oewn-01693676-s.tone: The drier of the pair - it names the tiresome self-importance almost clinically, without the heavy roll of *platitudinous*.

platitudinous.oewn-01693676-s.label: negative

family.axis: staleness held in contempt → plain absence of freshness

platitudinous.oewn-01693676-s.tone: A weightier, more sonorous word than *platitudinal*, and its own bulk is part of the mockery: dullness dressed up and then shown up.

painful.oewn-01715524-a.label: negative

family.axis: dull local soreness → extreme, torture-grade pain

painful.oewn-01715524-a.tone: The plain term of the family - it reports that something hurts, in the body or in the mind, without saying how sharply or how much.

aching.oewn-01715918-s.label: negative

family.axis: dull local soreness → extreme, torture-grade pain

aching.oewn-01715918-s.tone: Low and unbroken - a pain with no edge on it, the opposite of the sting in *biting*.

achy.oewn-01715918-s.label: negative

family.axis: dull local soreness → extreme, torture-grade pain

achy.oewn-01715918-s.tone: Informal where *aching* is plain, and the shortened shape keeps the same dull, steady pain small.

agonized.oewn-01716067-s.label: negative

family.axis: dull local soreness → extreme, torture-grade pain

agonized.oewn-01716067-s.tone: Turned outward - it describes the look or the cry that shows pain, agony included, not the thing doing the hurting.

agonised.oewn-01716067-s.label: negative

family.axis: dull local soreness → extreme, torture-grade pain

agonised.oewn-01716067-s.tone: The British spelling of *agonized* and identical in force - distress made visible rather than inflicted.

agonizing.oewn-01716177-s.label: negative

family.axis: dull local soreness → extreme, torture-grade pain

agonizing.oewn-01716177-s.tone: Far past *aching* - the pain is extreme, and the word lends it agony's whole weight.

agonising.oewn-01716177-s.label: negative

family.axis: dull local soreness → extreme, torture-grade pain

agonising.oewn-01716177-s.tone: The British spelling of *agonizing*, with the same extremity and no softening.

excruciating.oewn-01716177-s.label: negative

family.axis: dull local soreness → extreme, torture-grade pain

excruciating.oewn-01716177-s.tone: The absolute of the set - it admits no degree above itself, so anything short of unbearable is overstated by it.

harrowing.oewn-01716177-s.label: negative

family.axis: dull local soreness → extreme, torture-grade pain

harrowing.oewn-01716177-s.tone: Extremity felt as an ordeal - where *excruciating* measures the pain, this measures what it costs whoever goes through it.

torturing.oewn-01716177-s.label: negative

family.axis: dull local soreness → extreme, torture-grade pain

torturing.oewn-01716177-s.tone: Extremity cast as an act - the pain is not merely present but done to someone, which *excruciating* never says.

torturous.oewn-01716177-s.label: negative

family.axis: dull local soreness → extreme, torture-grade pain

torturous.oewn-01716177-s.tone: The quality without the agent - pain of the order torture produces, said of the experience rather than of anyone inflicting it.

torturesome.oewn-01716177-s.label: negative

family.axis: dull local soreness → extreme, torture-grade pain

torturesome.oewn-01716177-s.tone: The heavier build beside *torturous* - identical extremity, carried in a more laboured word.

biting.oewn-01716363-s.label: negative

family.axis: dull local soreness → extreme, torture-grade pain

biting.oewn-01716363-s.tone: Sharp and stinging where *aching* is dull, and cold above all is what it is said of.

bitter.oewn-01716363-s.label: negative

family.axis: dull local soreness → extreme, torture-grade pain

bitter.oewn-01716363-s.tone: The same sharp sting held as a condition rather than an act - a bitter cold surrounds you where a biting one goes at you.

chafed.oewn-01716529-s.label: negative

family.axis: dull local soreness → extreme, torture-grade pain

chafed.oewn-01716529-s.tone: Small and local - the soreness of skin rubbed raw, at the shallow end of everything else here.

galled.oewn-01716529-s.label: negative

family.axis: dull local soreness → extreme, torture-grade pain

galled.oewn-01716529-s.tone: Blunter than *chafed* for the same abraded skin, with the sore itself in view rather than the rubbing that made it.

possible.oewn-01826770-a.label: neutral

family.axis: bare possibility, merely not ruled out → endorsed as practically sound

possible.oewn-01826770-a.tone: The bare floor of the family - it says only that the thing is not ruled out, and promises nothing about anyone being able to bring it off.

accomplishable.oewn-01827194-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare possibility, merely not ruled out → endorsed as practically sound

accomplishable.oewn-01827194-s.tone: Formal and effortful, it frames the thing as a task with a finish line where *possible* frames nothing at all.

achievable.oewn-01827194-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare possibility, merely not ruled out → endorsed as practically sound

achievable.oewn-01827194-s.tone: Warmer than *accomplishable* - it treats the thing as a goal worth reaching and quietly credits whoever would reach it.

doable.oewn-01827194-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare possibility, merely not ruled out → endorsed as practically sound

doable.oewn-01827194-s.tone: The plainest and most informal of the set, it shrinks a thing down to size in a way *accomplishable* never manages.

manageable.oewn-01827194-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare possibility, merely not ruled out → endorsed as practically sound

manageable.oewn-01827194-s.tone: Concedes that the thing will take effort and says it fits inside capacity anyway, a fainter endorsement than *achievable*.

realizable.oewn-01827194-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare possibility, merely not ruled out → endorsed as practically sound

realizable.oewn-01827194-s.tone: Formal, and it looks past the doing to the outcome - the thing brought from prospect into fact.

affirmable.oewn-01827424-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare possibility, merely not ruled out → endorsed as practically sound

affirmable.oewn-01827424-s.tone: Technical and colourless: it rates whether a claim can be stood behind, and passes no judgement on the claim itself.

assertable.oewn-01827424-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare possibility, merely not ruled out → endorsed as practically sound

assertable.oewn-01827424-s.tone: Blunter in its verb than *affirmable* - putting a claim forward rather than standing behind one - but it carries no more approval.

attainable.oewn-01827657-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare possibility, merely not ruled out → endorsed as practically sound

attainable.oewn-01827657-s.tone: Points at something wanted and says the reach is long enough, giving it a pull toward the goal that *possible* has none of.

come-at-able.oewn-01827657-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare possibility, merely not ruled out → endorsed as practically sound

come-at-able.oewn-01827657-s.tone: Informal and homely, it makes the thing sound simply within arm's length, deflating the reach that *attainable* dignifies.

contingent.oewn-01827915-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare possibility, merely not ruled out → endorsed as practically sound

contingent.oewn-01827915-s.tone: The one member that withholds - it grants the possibility and in the same breath refuses to promise it, hedging where *feasible* endorses.

feasible.oewn-01828067-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare possibility, merely not ruled out → endorsed as practically sound

feasible.oewn-01828067-s.tone: A working verdict rather than a hope: it says the thing can be done with what is at hand now, a test *possible* never applies.

executable.oewn-01828067-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare possibility, merely not ruled out → endorsed as practically sound

executable.oewn-01828067-s.tone: The most procedural of the set, it asks only whether the steps can be carried out and offers no opinion on whether they should be.

practicable.oewn-01828067-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare possibility, merely not ruled out → endorsed as practically sound

practicable.oewn-01828067-s.tone: Formal and faintly grudging, it certifies that a thing can be put into practice without claiming it will go well, unlike *viable*.

viable.oewn-01828067-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare possibility, merely not ruled out → endorsed as practically sound

viable.oewn-01828067-s.tone: The strongest endorsement here - it declares a plan sound enough to go ahead on as things stand, where *workable* says only that it will function.

workable.oewn-01828067-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare possibility, merely not ruled out → endorsed as practically sound

workable.oewn-01828067-s.tone: Modest and practical - it promises the thing will function, not that it will succeed.

composed.oewn-00531471-a.label: positive

family.axis: untroubled stillness → unshakeable command of oneself under pressure

composed.oewn-00531471-a.tone: Approving of steadiness held on purpose - the serenity is a bearing kept up while the pressure is on, not the luck of an easy hour.

calm.oewn-00531862-s.label: positive

family.axis: untroubled stillness → unshakeable command of oneself under pressure

calm.oewn-00531862-s.tone: The plain word of the family - mildly approving, naming the absence of agitation without the lift *serene* gives the same state.

unagitated.oewn-00531862-s.label: neutral

family.axis: untroubled stillness → unshakeable command of oneself under pressure

unagitated.oewn-00531862-s.tone: Flatly descriptive: it registers that agitation is absent without crediting anyone for holding it off.

serene.oewn-00531862-s.label: positive

family.axis: untroubled stillness → unshakeable command of oneself under pressure

serene.oewn-00531862-s.tone: Raises the same unagitated state into something luminous and admired, where *calm* merely reports it.

tranquil.oewn-00531862-s.label: positive

family.axis: untroubled stillness → unshakeable command of oneself under pressure

tranquil.oewn-00531862-s.tone: The stillest word here - the self-possession sounds effortless rather than exerted, unlike the braced steadiness of *composed*.

imperturbable.oewn-00532252-s.label: positive

family.axis: untroubled stillness → unshakeable command of oneself under pressure

imperturbable.oewn-00532252-s.tone: Stately and strong: it describes calm that cannot be shaken, not merely calm that happens to be unshaken.

unflappable.oewn-00532252-s.label: positive

family.axis: untroubled stillness → unshakeable command of oneself under pressure

unflappable.oewn-00532252-s.tone: Informal and warmly admiring where *imperturbable* is dignified, praising the same immunity to upset in cheerful terms.

collected.oewn-00532559-s.label: positive

family.axis: untroubled stillness → unshakeable command of oneself under pressure

collected.oewn-00532559-s.tone: Plain approval for having one's faculties gathered and in hand - steady rather than impressive.

equanimous.oewn-00532559-s.label: positive

family.axis: untroubled stillness → unshakeable command of oneself under pressure

equanimous.oewn-00532559-s.tone: Formal, and it prizes evenness above all: control that holds the level rather than control that shows.

poised.oewn-00532559-s.label: positive

family.axis: untroubled stillness → unshakeable command of oneself under pressure

poised.oewn-00532559-s.tone: Adds bearing to the control - the faculties are not just held but held gracefully, which *collected* never claims.

self-collected.oewn-00532559-s.label: positive

family.axis: untroubled stillness → unshakeable command of oneself under pressure

self-collected.oewn-00532559-s.tone: Credits the control explicitly to the person exercising it, sounding more effortful than the smooth *poised*.

self-contained.oewn-00532559-s.label: positive

family.axis: untroubled stillness → unshakeable command of oneself under pressure

self-contained.oewn-00532559-s.tone: Praises control that needs nothing from anyone else, with a reserve at its edge that *poised* does not carry.

self-possessed.oewn-00532559-s.label: positive

family.axis: untroubled stillness → unshakeable command of oneself under pressure

self-possessed.oewn-00532559-s.tone: Weightier than *collected*: the faculties are owned rather than merely gathered, and the ownership is the compliment.

cool.oewn-00532977-s.label: positive

family.axis: untroubled stillness → unshakeable command of oneself under pressure

cool.oewn-00532977-s.tone: Informal approval with a chill in it - the self-control reads as unbothered, and the unemotional side can tip into indifference.

coolheaded.oewn-00532977-s.label: positive

family.axis: untroubled stillness → unshakeable command of oneself under pressure

coolheaded.oewn-00532977-s.tone: Puts the weight on judgement rather than temperature, praising the head that keeps working when circumstances turn trying.

nerveless.oewn-00532977-s.label: neutral

family.axis: untroubled stillness → unshakeable command of oneself under pressure

nerveless.oewn-00532977-s.tone: Frames the composure as the sheer absence of nerves, which reads as coldness as readily as courage.

weak.oewn-02332106-a.label: negative

family.axis: plainly noting a want of strength → dismissing a thing as too weak to count

weak.oewn-02332106-a.tone: The flat baseline of the family - it names the missing physical strength and stops there, where every sharper member adds an attitude to the same fact.

anemic.oewn-02332508-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly noting a want of strength → dismissing a thing as too weak to count

anemic.oewn-02332508-s.tone: Turns the missing vigor into something thin and drained, as though what is left had been diluted rather than merely reduced.

anaemic.oewn-02332508-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly noting a want of strength → dismissing a thing as too weak to count

anaemic.oewn-02332508-s.tone: The British spelling, carrying the identical sting - vigor thinned out, not simply lessened.

adynamic.oewn-02332671-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plainly noting a want of strength → dismissing a thing as too weak to count

adynamic.oewn-02332671-s.tone: Clinical in register, presenting the absence of energy as a condition to be observed rather than a failing to be scored.

asthenic.oewn-02332671-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plainly noting a want of strength → dismissing a thing as too weak to count

asthenic.oewn-02332671-s.tone: Technical rather than evaluative - the want of vitality reads as a settled characteristic, not the temporary drain that *enervated* implies.

debilitated.oewn-02332671-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly noting a want of strength → dismissing a thing as too weak to count

debilitated.oewn-02332671-s.tone: Implies vitality that was once there and has been taken away, so it asks for sympathy where *lame* asks for scorn.

enervated.oewn-02332671-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly noting a want of strength → dismissing a thing as too weak to count

enervated.oewn-02332671-s.tone: The vitality has gone slack rather than been broken, leaving a limp, unstrung quality that *debilitated* renders as damage.

faint.oewn-02332825-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly noting a want of strength → dismissing a thing as too weak to count

faint.oewn-02332825-s.tone: The mildest way of falling short - strength barely registering rather than failing, nearer to almost-nothing than to inadequacy.

feeble.oewn-02332825-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly noting a want of strength → dismissing a thing as too weak to count

feeble.oewn-02332825-s.tone: Harsher than *faint* for the same shortfall - the lack sounds pitiable, and pity here shades into a verdict that it was never going to be enough.

lame.oewn-02333032-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly noting a want of strength → dismissing a thing as too weak to count

lame.oewn-02333032-s.tone: Withering - the failure is not merely ineffective but embarrassing, contemptible for having been attempted at all.

flimsy.oewn-02333212-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly noting a want of strength → dismissing a thing as too weak to count

flimsy.oewn-02333212-s.tone: The weakness is structural and imminent: the thing will give way under any real pressure.

insubstantial.oewn-02333212-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly noting a want of strength → dismissing a thing as too weak to count

insubstantial.oewn-02333212-s.tone: Cooler and more formal than *flimsy* - there is simply not enough there to be solid, with no promise of collapse attached.

jerry-built.oewn-02333471-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly noting a want of strength → dismissing a thing as too weak to count

jerry-built.oewn-02333471-s.tone: Damns the making rather than the thing - it says somebody rushed it or botched it, and the word will not let that go.

pale.oewn-02333753-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plainly noting a want of strength → dismissing a thing as too weak to count

pale.oewn-02333753-s.tone: Of light, it reports thin brightness plainly, without the sickliness *pallid* or the melancholy *wan* brings to the same dimness.

pallid.oewn-02333753-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly noting a want of strength → dismissing a thing as too weak to count

pallid.oewn-02333753-s.tone: Makes the dim light sound drained and washed out, an unwell version of what *pale* states neutrally.

wan.oewn-02333753-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly noting a want of strength → dismissing a thing as too weak to count

wan.oewn-02333753-s.tone: The weak light sounds dispirited, a dimness with something melancholy in it that *pale* would only measure.

guilty.oewn-01323940-a.label: negative

family.axis: liable to a penalty → condemned for grave wrong

guilty.oewn-01323940-a.tone: The family's plain verdict, covering both the one who did the reprehensible act and the one merely chargeable with it - responsibility and accusation under a single word.

guilty.oewn-00155850-s.label: negative

family.axis: a passing inward discomfort → a public and settled loss of standing

guilty.oewn-00155850-s.tone: The plainest of the words for guilt that shows, naming what is visible without the picture *hangdog* draws.

at_fault.oewn-01324381-s.label: negative

family.axis: liable to a penalty → condemned for grave wrong

at_fault.oewn-01324381-s.tone: Mildest of the blame words, locating blame without characterising the deed, where *guilty* already calls the act reprehensible.

blameworthy.oewn-01324481-s.label: negative

family.axis: liable to a penalty → condemned for grave wrong

blameworthy.oewn-01324481-s.tone: Weighs the deed and finds it has earned censure, a considered verdict rather than *at fault*'s bare attribution.

blamable.oewn-01324481-s.label: negative

family.axis: liable to a penalty → condemned for grave wrong

blamable.oewn-01324481-s.tone: Flat and formal, stating only that blame may properly be laid, without *blameworthy*'s sense that the deed went out and earned it.

blameable.oewn-01324481-s.label: negative

family.axis: liable to a penalty → condemned for grave wrong

blameable.oewn-01324481-s.tone: Equally impersonal, taking the wrong, the evil and the merely injurious alike without changing temperature.

blameful.oewn-01324481-s.label: negative

family.axis: liable to a penalty → condemned for grave wrong

blameful.oewn-01324481-s.tone: Puts the blame inside the thing as a quality it is full of, where *blameworthy* says only that blame is deserved.

censurable.oewn-01324481-s.label: negative

family.axis: liable to a penalty → condemned for grave wrong

censurable.oewn-01324481-s.tone: Pitches the fault toward reproof that could be pronounced out loud, the most public-facing of these.

culpable.oewn-01324481-s.label: negative

family.axis: liable to a penalty → condemned for grave wrong

culpable.oewn-01324481-s.tone: The coolest of these, recording fault as a determination, which is why it sits as easily on the injurious as on the evil.

bloodguilty.oewn-01324891-s.label: negative

family.axis: liable to a penalty → condemned for grave wrong

bloodguilty.oewn-01324891-s.tone: The gravest here - guilt of killing rather than of a misdeed, and the word treats it as a stain carried rather than a charge answered.

chargeable.oewn-01324996-s.label: neutral

family.axis: liable to a penalty → condemned for grave wrong

chargeable.oewn-01324996-s.tone: Neutral and procedural, recording exposure to accusation and resting as readily on the cause as on the person, so it asserts no wrong.

indictable.oewn-01324996-s.label: negative

family.axis: liable to a penalty → condemned for grave wrong

indictable.oewn-01324996-s.tone: Weights that same liability toward formal accusation, sounding graver than *chargeable* while claiming no more guilt.

conscience-smitten.oewn-01325188-s.label: neutral

family.axis: liable to a penalty → condemned for grave wrong

conscience-smitten.oewn-01325188-s.tone: The one inward member, guilt felt from inside rather than laid on from outside, with the conscience itself doing the striking.

criminal.oewn-01325275-s.label: negative

family.axis: liable to a penalty → condemned for grave wrong

criminal.oewn-01325275-s.tone: Hard and total, making the wrongdoing a category the person belongs to, and it reaches past crime proper to any serious offense.

delinquent.oewn-01325440-s.label: negative

family.axis: liable to a penalty → condemned for grave wrong

delinquent.oewn-01325440-s.tone: Lighter than *criminal* by the size of the deed, chiding a misdeed rather than condemning a crime.

finable.oewn-01325573-s.label: neutral

family.axis: liable to a penalty → condemned for grave wrong

finable.oewn-01325573-s.tone: Purely procedural, measuring the offence as money owed and judging the offender not at all.

fineable.oewn-01325573-s.label: neutral

family.axis: liable to a penalty → condemned for grave wrong

fineable.oewn-01325573-s.tone: As bloodless as *finable* - a penalty attaches, and nothing is said about the wrong or the wrongdoer.

cold.oewn-01260684-a.label: negative

family.axis: feeling simply absent → chill aimed at someone as disdain

cold.oewn-01260684-a.tone: The flat, unfigured term for the whole condition, naming the missing human warmth without deciding whether it is a settled nature or a rebuff aimed at someone.

emotionless.oewn-01261062-s.label: negative

family.axis: feeling simply absent → chill aimed at someone as disdain

emotionless.oewn-01261062-s.tone: Near-clinical: it reports feeling as simply absent from the person, with none of the unfriendliness *icy* points at a target.

passionless.oewn-01261062-s.label: negative

family.axis: feeling simply absent → chill aimed at someone as disdain

passionless.oewn-01261062-s.tone: Where *emotionless* records no feeling at all, this faults a missing ardour, the flatness of something that ought to have had fire in it.

frigid.oewn-01261336-s.label: negative

family.axis: feeling simply absent → chill aimed at someone as disdain

frigid.oewn-01261336-s.tone: Severe and unbending, the coldness hardened into a settled refusal of cordiality rather than the passing chill of *frosty*.

frosty.oewn-01261336-s.label: negative

family.axis: feeling simply absent → chill aimed at someone as disdain

frosty.oewn-01261336-s.tone: The lightest chill of the group, a manner cooled and capable of thawing, not the fixed disdain of *glacial*.

frozen.oewn-01261336-s.label: negative

family.axis: feeling simply absent → chill aimed at someone as disdain

frozen.oewn-01261336-s.tone: Coldness as arrest: cordiality not merely withheld but stopped dead, the unfriendliness locked in place.

glacial.oewn-01261336-s.label: negative

family.axis: feeling simply absent → chill aimed at someone as disdain

glacial.oewn-01261336-s.tone: The heaviest cold here, vast and immovable, a disdain that takes no trouble to hide itself.

icy.oewn-01261336-s.label: negative

family.axis: feeling simply absent → chill aimed at someone as disdain

icy.oewn-01261336-s.tone: Cold with an edge on it, the chill pointed at someone and meant to cut, where *wintry* only surrounds them.

wintry.oewn-01261336-s.label: negative

family.axis: feeling simply absent → chill aimed at someone as disdain

wintry.oewn-01261336-s.tone: Bleak rather than sharp, an unwelcoming climate about the person instead of the single stroke of *icy*.

heavy.oewn-01192305-a.label: negative

family.axis: wearing enough to tire → weighing down hard enough to smother

heavy.oewn-01192305-a.tone: The plainest name for the condition itself, sadness or trouble felt as weight from inside, where *burdensome* describes the load from outside.

burdensome.oewn-01192652-s.label: negative

family.axis: wearing enough to tire → weighing down hard enough to smother

burdensome.oewn-01192652-s.tone: Puts the difficulty in the thing rather than the bearer: a load fixed on you that has to be carried, not merely a strain that tires.

onerous.oewn-01192652-s.label: negative

family.axis: wearing enough to tire → weighing down hard enough to smother

onerous.oewn-01192652-s.tone: The formal member, and the heaviest-sounding of the three, where *taxing* keeps the same complaint everyday.

taxing.oewn-01192652-s.label: negative

family.axis: wearing enough to tire → weighing down hard enough to smother

taxing.oewn-01192652-s.tone: Leans on the wearing half of the sense, draining strength steadily rather than crushing, the lightest of the three.

distressing.oewn-01192929-s.label: negative

family.axis: wearing enough to tire → weighing down hard enough to smother

distressing.oewn-01192929-s.tone: The plain, full-strength member of the group, naming real hurt and not merely unease.

distressful.oewn-01192929-s.label: negative

family.axis: wearing enough to tire → weighing down hard enough to smother

distressful.oewn-01192929-s.tone: The stiffer, more formal shape of *distressing*, with the same weight of hurt behind it.

disturbing.oewn-01192929-s.label: negative

family.axis: wearing enough to tire → weighing down hard enough to smother

disturbing.oewn-01192929-s.tone: Aimed at composure rather than comfort, it unsettles and goes on unsettling, where *distressing* simply hurts.

perturbing.oewn-01192929-s.label: negative

family.axis: wearing enough to tire → weighing down hard enough to smother

perturbing.oewn-01192929-s.tone: Takes the trouble as agitation rather than dread - a settled mind stirred out of its even running - which makes it a lighter and more momentary thing than the unsettling *disturbing* keeps up.

troubling.oewn-01192929-s.label: negative

family.axis: wearing enough to tire → weighing down hard enough to smother

troubling.oewn-01192929-s.tone: Quiet and persistent, a worry that nags at you instead of striking, understated beside *distressing*.

worrisome.oewn-01192929-s.label: negative

family.axis: wearing enough to tire → weighing down hard enough to smother

worrisome.oewn-01192929-s.tone: Treats the power to cause anxiety as a standing property of the thing, where *worrying* reports what it is doing now.

worrying.oewn-01192929-s.label: negative

family.axis: wearing enough to tire → weighing down hard enough to smother

worrying.oewn-01192929-s.tone: Keeps to the worry-and-anxiety end of the sense, unease rather than the hurt *distressing* names.

leaden.oewn-01193396-s.label: negative

family.axis: wearing enough to tire → weighing down hard enough to smother

leaden.oewn-01193396-s.tone: The most physical word in the family, heaviness and weariness fused into dead metal, dull and unliftable.

weighted.oewn-01193396-s.label: negative

family.axis: wearing enough to tire → weighing down hard enough to smother

weighted.oewn-01193396-s.tone: The flattest member, recording that the weight has been put on without making the weariness of it felt as *leaden* does.

oppressive.oewn-01193541-s.label: negative

family.axis: wearing enough to tire → weighing down hard enough to smother

oppressive.oewn-01193541-s.tone: The strongest weight here, pressing on the senses as much as on the spirit and leaving no room to breathe.

weighty.oewn-01193711-s.label: negative

family.axis: wearing enough to tire → weighing down hard enough to smother

weighty.oewn-01193711-s.tone: Grave rather than smothering, the weight registering as anxiety carried, where *oppressive* closes in.

discriminating.oewn-00777882-a.label: positive

family.axis: bare capacity to tell things apart → refined taste that earns praise

discriminating.oewn-00777882-a.tone: Praise for judgment fine enough to show itself in taste, where *selective* reports only that choices are being made.

appreciative.oewn-00778235-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare capacity to tell things apart → refined taste that earns praise

appreciative.oewn-00778235-s.tone: Warm rather than cool - the judgment it names is a favourable one, or else plain appreciation, where *discriminating* says only that the judgment is fine.

diacritic.oewn-00778470-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare capacity to tell things apart → refined taste that earns praise

diacritic.oewn-00778470-s.tone: Flatly technical: a capacity to tell things apart, carrying none of the credit *discriminating* hands whoever has it.

diacritical.oewn-00778470-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare capacity to tell things apart → refined taste that earns praise

diacritical.oewn-00778470-s.tone: The same bare power of distinguishing, stated as a property of the thing that separates rather than a compliment to it.

discerning.oewn-00778694-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare capacity to tell things apart → refined taste that earns praise

discerning.oewn-00778694-s.tone: Praise aimed at fineness of perception - it can both produce and catch effects too subtle for a coarser eye, where *selective* only picks among what is already plain.

discriminative.oewn-00778860-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare capacity to tell things apart → refined taste that earns praise

discriminative.oewn-00778860-s.tone: A faculty word - the fineness sits in the distinctions themselves, not in any credit to whoever makes them.

discriminatory.oewn-00778860-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare capacity to tell things apart → refined taste that earns praise

discriminatory.oewn-00778860-s.tone: Names the same capacity as *discriminative* and stays as neutral about it, describing a power to separate rather than approving its exercise.

eclectic.oewn-00779045-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare capacity to tell things apart → refined taste that earns praise

eclectic.oewn-00779045-s.tone: Approving of breadth: the choosing ranges across styles and takes the best of each, where *selective* only narrows.

good.oewn-00779170-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare capacity to tell things apart → refined taste that earns praise

good.oewn-00779170-s.tone: The broadest approval here - admiration granted with none of the account of the judgment behind it that *discriminating* insists on.

selective.oewn-00779252-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare capacity to tell things apart → refined taste that earns praise

selective.oewn-00779252-s.tone: Mild credit for care in choosing, covering both the habit of picking and the carefulness of the pick, without claiming the taste *discriminating* asserts.

malfunctioning.oewn-01095835-a.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral report that something is not working → blunt condemnation of the thing that failed

malfunctioning.oewn-01095835-a.tone: Clinical and blameless — it reports the failure as something happening in the working, where *bad* condemns the thing outright.

nonfunctional.oewn-01095835-a.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral report that something is not working → blunt condemnation of the thing that failed

nonfunctional.oewn-01095835-a.tone: Flatly negative where *malfunctioning* implies a thing still trying: the function is simply absent, stated as a condition rather than a misbehaviour.

amiss.oewn-01096064-s.label: negative

family.axis: neutral report that something is not working → blunt condemnation of the thing that failed

amiss.oewn-01096064-s.tone: The gentlest word here — it registers that something is off without saying how far or how badly.

awry.oewn-01096064-s.label: negative

family.axis: neutral report that something is not working → blunt condemnation of the thing that failed

awry.oewn-01096064-s.tone: More visual than *amiss*, the working gone crooked rather than merely faltering, but pressing no harder.

haywire.oewn-01096064-s.label: negative

family.axis: neutral report that something is not working → blunt condemnation of the thing that failed

haywire.oewn-01096064-s.tone: Informal and loud — not a quiet fault but a thing thrashing beyond control.

wrong.oewn-01096064-s.label: negative

family.axis: neutral report that something is not working → blunt condemnation of the thing that failed

wrong.oewn-01096064-s.tone: The barest of them, saying only that something is not as it should be, with none of *haywire*'s noise.

bad.oewn-01096265-s.label: negative

family.axis: neutral report that something is not working → blunt condemnation of the thing that failed

bad.oewn-01096265-s.tone: Blunt and wholesale — it writes the thing off as no good instead of naming what has gone wrong inside it.

bad.oewn-01164319-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare capacity to do damage → damage deliberately dealt to a person or a name

bad.oewn-01164319-s.tone: The blunt monosyllable for the capacity *harmful* names, warning that a thing can hurt without saying how or how much.

defective.oewn-01096265-s.label: negative

family.axis: neutral report that something is not working → blunt condemnation of the thing that failed

defective.oewn-01096265-s.tone: Puts the fault inside the thing as a flaw it carries, cooler and more damning than *bad*.

out_of_whack.oewn-01096420-s.label: negative

family.axis: neutral report that something is not working → blunt condemnation of the thing that failed

out_of_whack.oewn-01096420-s.tone: Informal and forgiving — the trouble is balance or adjustment, something slipped rather than broken.

run-down.oewn-01096582-s.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral report that something is not working → blunt condemnation of the thing that failed

run-down.oewn-01096582-s.tone: Purely mechanical: the spring has unwound, a state to be wound back and no reflection on the thing.

odorous.oewn-01058772-a.label: neutral

family.axis: a smell merely reported → a smell pinned to one named source

odorous.oewn-01058772-a.tone: The family's base term, covering both that a smell is present at all and that the thing has a smell of its own, and alone here it never says which smell.

alliaceous.oewn-01059381-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a smell merely reported → a smell pinned to one named source

alliaceous.oewn-01059381-s.tone: Formal where the rest of the family is plain compounding, and it holds onion and garlic together rather than settling on either.

almond-scented.oewn-01059466-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a smell merely reported → a smell pinned to one named source

almond-scented.oewn-01059466-s.tone: A flat identification of the source, describing the smell as almond's without any suggestion that this is welcome.

anise-scented.oewn-01059545-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a smell merely reported → a smell pinned to one named source

anise-scented.oewn-01059545-s.tone: Names a licorice-sharp source where *almond-scented* names a softer one, though the word itself is equally free of praise or complaint.

apple-scented.oewn-01059622-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a smell merely reported → a smell pinned to one named source

apple-scented.oewn-01059622-s.tone: Takes its smell from a fruit rather than a spice or a resin, and like every compound here it identifies without evaluating.

balsam-scented.oewn-01059700-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a smell merely reported → a smell pinned to one named source

balsam-scented.oewn-01059700-s.tone: Fixes the smell to the resin rather than to the tree, making it the most exactly specified member of the family.

candy-scented.oewn-01059785-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a smell merely reported → a smell pinned to one named source

candy-scented.oewn-01059785-s.tone: The one compound whose source is a made thing rather than a plant, and it names that smell with no verdict attached.

cedar-scented.oewn-01059862-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a smell merely reported → a smell pinned to one named source

cedar-scented.oewn-01059862-s.tone: Takes its smell from a wood, not from a spice, a fruit or a sweet, and names the tree whole where *balsam-scented* narrows to a resin.

cinnamon-scented.oewn-01059941-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a smell merely reported → a smell pinned to one named source

cinnamon-scented.oewn-01059941-s.tone: Warm where *mint-scented* is cool, though the warmth belongs to the spice and not to the compound, which identifies the smell as flatly as *clove-scented* names a sharper one.

clove-scented.oewn-01060024-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a smell merely reported → a smell pinned to one named source

clove-scented.oewn-01060024-s.tone: Names the sharper of the two baking spices here, yet the word passes judgement no more than *cinnamon-scented* does.

ginger-scented.oewn-01060101-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a smell merely reported → a smell pinned to one named source

ginger-scented.oewn-01060101-s.tone: Third of the kitchen spices in the family, labelling a smell by its source without hinting whether it pleases.

honey-scented.oewn-01060180-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a smell merely reported → a smell pinned to one named source

honey-scented.oewn-01060180-s.tone: The sweetness sits in the source, not in the word, which reports it as flatly as *musk-scented* reports a heavier smell.

lemon-scented.oewn-01060257-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a smell merely reported → a smell pinned to one named source

lemon-scented.oewn-01060257-s.tone: Borrows a fruit as *apple-scented* does, the sour one against the sweet, with neither compound taking a side.

mint-scented.oewn-01060335-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a smell merely reported → a smell pinned to one named source

mint-scented.oewn-01060335-s.tone: Cool where *cinnamon-scented* is warm, but that contrast belongs to the sources named and not to anything the words themselves approve.

musk-scented.oewn-01060410-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a smell merely reported → a smell pinned to one named source

musk-scented.oewn-01060410-s.tone: The one animal source among plants, spices and sweets, and the compound states it without the faintest verdict.

musky-scented.oewn-01060410-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a smell merely reported → a smell pinned to one named source

musky-scented.oewn-01060410-s.tone: Carries the same sense as *musk-scented*, the -y form loosening the compound without changing what it identifies.

bloody.oewn-00248306-a.label: neutral

family.axis: blood merely present → appetite for killing

bloody.oewn-00248306-a.tone: The plain base of the family, equally at home with blood held, blood on the surface, or blood merely attending, and judging none of the three.

blood-filled.oewn-00248735-s.label: neutral

family.axis: blood merely present → appetite for killing

blood-filled.oewn-00248735-s.tone: Purely locational where *bloody* is open - the blood is inside the thing, a fact of contents with no verdict attached.

bloodstained.oewn-00248860-s.label: negative

family.axis: blood merely present → appetite for killing

bloodstained.oewn-00248860-s.tone: Treats the covering as a mark left behind, so the blood mars what it lies on rather than simply coating it.

gory.oewn-00248860-s.label: negative

family.axis: blood merely present → appetite for killing

gory.oewn-00248860-s.tone: Lurid where *bloodstained* is sober - the same covering turned into spectacle, with the recoil built in.

bloodsucking.oewn-00248985-s.label: negative

family.axis: blood merely present → appetite for killing

bloodsucking.oewn-00248985-s.tone: Frames the drawing of blood as feeding off another, so the offence is parasitism rather than violence.

bloodthirsty.oewn-00249118-s.label: negative

family.axis: blood merely present → appetite for killing

bloodthirsty.oewn-00249118-s.tone: Makes the violence an appetite - it condemns the wanting, not the doing.

bloody-minded.oewn-00249118-s.label: negative

family.axis: blood merely present → appetite for killing

bloody-minded.oewn-00249118-s.tone: Sites the same eagerness in the temperament, a settled cast of mind rather than the thirst *bloodthirsty* makes of it.

sanguinary.oewn-00249118-s.label: negative

family.axis: blood merely present → appetite for killing

sanguinary.oewn-00249118-s.tone: Formal, and the cool register lands strangely on an eagerness for bloodshed, condemning at arm's length where *bloodthirsty* condemns close up.

crimson.oewn-00249427-s.label: negative

family.axis: blood merely present → appetite for killing

crimson.oewn-00249427-s.tone: Names violence by its colour, so the judgement arrives as an image and the word never has to state it.

red.oewn-00249427-s.label: negative

family.axis: blood merely present → appetite for killing

red.oewn-00249427-s.tone: The barest of the figures - the colour carries the violence with none of the heightening *crimson* brings to it.

violent.oewn-00249427-s.label: negative

family.axis: blood merely present → appetite for killing

violent.oewn-00249427-s.tone: Says outright what *crimson* and *red* say by figure, and holds whether blood is shed or only violence done.

homicidal.oewn-00249704-s.label: negative

family.axis: blood merely present → appetite for killing

homicidal.oewn-00249704-s.tone: Clinical in register and wide in reach, covering the settled tendency, the bare capacity, and the character of the act alike.

murderous.oewn-00249704-s.label: negative

family.axis: blood merely present → appetite for killing

murderous.oewn-00249704-s.tone: Brings the weight of the crime to the same range *homicidal* covers coolly, condemning in the act of describing.

sanguineous.oewn-00249970-s.label: negative

family.axis: blood merely present → appetite for killing

sanguineous.oewn-00249970-s.tone: Formal and cool, marking only that bloodshed attends - a circumstance noted, not an appetite exposed.

slaughterous.oewn-00249970-s.label: negative

family.axis: blood merely present → appetite for killing

slaughterous.oewn-00249970-s.tone: Makes the attending bloodshed sound wholesale, its weight falling on scale where *sanguineous* stays even.

clear.oewn-00429900-a.label: neutral

family.axis: obviousness held against a thing → clarity counted to its credit

clear.oewn-00429900-a.tone: The plain term for the property, stating that a thing reaches the mind without effort and passing no judgement on whether that is a merit.

broad.oewn-00430374-s.label: negative

family.axis: obviousness held against a thing → clarity counted to its credit

broad.oewn-00430374-s.tone: Faintly disapproving - the obviousness is heard as something laid on too thickly, an excess where *unsubtle* reports only a lack.

unsubtle.oewn-00430374-s.label: negative

family.axis: obviousness held against a thing → clarity counted to its credit

unsubtle.oewn-00430374-s.tone: Criticism by subtraction - it names the delicacy that is missing rather than the heaviness that replaced it, so the fault reads as a deficiency.

clear-cut.oewn-00430512-s.label: positive

family.axis: obviousness held against a thing → clarity counted to its credit

clear-cut.oewn-00430512-s.tone: Approving of edges - the outline is sharp enough that there is no blurred margin left to argue over.

distinct.oewn-00430512-s.label: neutral

family.axis: obviousness held against a thing → clarity counted to its credit

distinct.oewn-00430512-s.tone: The cool member of its group - sharpness of definition reported as a fact, without the approval in *clear-cut* or the bite of *trenchant*.

trenchant.oewn-00430512-s.label: positive

family.axis: obviousness held against a thing → clarity counted to its credit

trenchant.oewn-00430512-s.tone: Praise with an edge on it - the definition cuts rather than merely bounds, a force *distinct* never claims.

limpid.oewn-00430851-s.label: positive

family.axis: obviousness held against a thing → clarity counted to its credit

limpid.oewn-00430851-s.tone: Praise for language that offers no resistance at all, clarity felt as smoothness rather than as precision.

lucid.oewn-00430851-s.label: positive

family.axis: obviousness held against a thing → clarity counted to its credit

lucid.oewn-00430851-s.tone: Plainer praise than *limpid* - the clarity is credited to the ordering of the thought rather than to the ease of the surface.

luculent.oewn-00430851-s.label: positive

family.axis: obviousness held against a thing → clarity counted to its credit

luculent.oewn-00430851-s.tone: Formal to the point of ornament - the compliment is paid in exactly the diction the clarity it commends would strip out.

pellucid.oewn-00430851-s.label: positive

family.axis: obviousness held against a thing → clarity counted to its credit

pellucid.oewn-00430851-s.tone: Polished praise - the language is treated as something seen straight through, admired for the absence of anything between reader and sense.

crystal_clear.oewn-00430851-s.label: positive

family.axis: obviousness held against a thing → clarity counted to its credit

crystal_clear.oewn-00430851-s.tone: The blunt, emphatic option - it insists nothing has been left to misread, with none of the polish of *pellucid*.

perspicuous.oewn-00430851-s.label: positive

family.axis: obviousness held against a thing → clarity counted to its credit

perspicuous.oewn-00430851-s.tone: Formal and assessing - clarity approved as a property the language can be judged to have, not a pleasure it gives.

prima_facie.oewn-00431289-s.label: neutral

family.axis: obviousness held against a thing → clarity counted to its credit

prima_facie.oewn-00431289-s.tone: Neutral and provisional - it marks how a thing stands on first sight and reserves whatever a closer look might overturn.

unmistakable.oewn-00431405-s.label: neutral

family.axis: obviousness held against a thing → clarity counted to its credit

unmistakable.oewn-00431405-s.tone: Force without approval - it makes clarity a matter of no other reading being available, which serves the unwelcome as readily as the welcome.

vivid.oewn-00431537-s.label: positive

family.axis: obviousness held against a thing → clarity counted to its credit

vivid.oewn-00431537-s.tone: Warm praise - the clarity comes with the freshness of something being undergone now, not merely well set out.

depressing.oewn-00365559-a.label: negative

family.axis: cheer merely absent → gloom that presses hard

depressing.oewn-00365559-a.tone: Blunt and unhedged, it names the effect on the person outright, reaching self-regard as well as mood where *cheerless* only reports what is missing.

cheerless.oewn-00365559-a.label: negative

family.axis: cheer merely absent → gloom that presses hard

cheerless.oewn-00365559-a.tone: Works by absence — nothing here to lift anyone — so it sinks the spirits without ever accusing the thing of anything.

uncheerful.oewn-00365559-a.label: negative

family.axis: cheer merely absent → gloom that presses hard

uncheerful.oewn-00365559-a.tone: The flattest of these, a bare negation registering the missing cheer without the settled bleakness *cheerless* carries.

blue.oewn-00365961-s.label: negative

family.axis: cheer merely absent → gloom that presses hard

blue.oewn-00365961-s.tone: Informal, and it tints the mood rather than convicting the thing - dejection carried as a colour, where *dark* throws a shadow over what it names and *dismal* passes sentence on it.

dark.oewn-00365961-s.label: negative

family.axis: cheer merely absent → gloom that presses hard

dark.oewn-00365961-s.tone: The dejection is cast over a thing rather than sitting inside it — a shadow, where *dreary* is a long dull stretch.

dark.oewn-00536470-s.label: negative

family.axis: a difficulty the reader can work at → understanding shut out entirely

dark.oewn-00536470-s.tone: Makes the hard style feel withheld rather than merely difficult, as though something were being kept unlit.

dingy.oewn-00365961-s.label: negative

family.axis: cheer merely absent → gloom that presses hard

dingy.oewn-00365961-s.tone: Dispirits in a small, unfreshened way, too minor for the sweep of *dismal* but enough to flatten a mood.

disconsolate.oewn-00365961-s.label: negative

family.axis: cheer merely absent → gloom that presses hard

disconsolate.oewn-00365961-s.tone: It marks a thing as past consoling, so the dejection comes with no way out of it, heavier in that than *gloomy*.

dismal.oewn-00365961-s.label: negative

family.axis: cheer merely absent → gloom that presses hard

dismal.oewn-00365961-s.tone: A flat, sweeping verdict of bleakness that sinks the spirits harder than *gloomy* and leaves nothing to salvage.

gloomy.oewn-00365961-s.label: negative

family.axis: cheer merely absent → gloom that presses hard

gloomy.oewn-00365961-s.tone: The plain middle of the family, naming the dejection without heightening it, where *dismal* passes judgement on it.

grim.oewn-00365961-s.label: negative

family.axis: cheer merely absent → gloom that presses hard

grim.oewn-00365961-s.tone: The hardest here, the gloom it causes carrying an edge of harshness, where *dreary* only wears you down.

sorry.oewn-00365961-s.label: negative

family.axis: cheer merely absent → gloom that presses hard

sorry.oewn-00365961-s.tone: Dejection mixed with contempt: what it names is not merely dispiriting but pitiable, which *gloomy* never implies.

drab.oewn-00365961-s.label: negative

family.axis: cheer merely absent → gloom that presses hard

drab.oewn-00365961-s.tone: Dejection by monotony — it flattens rather than darkens, dispiriting without the menace of *grim*.

drear.oewn-00365961-s.label: negative

family.axis: cheer merely absent → gloom that presses hard

drear.oewn-00365961-s.tone: Barer and more literary than *dreary*, the same gloom in a word with nothing spare left in it.

dreary.oewn-00365961-s.label: negative

family.axis: cheer merely absent → gloom that presses hard

dreary.oewn-00365961-s.tone: Gloom that goes on and wearies, so where *dismal* can be a single verdict this one drags.

somber.oewn-00366341-s.label: negative

family.axis: cheer merely absent → gloom that presses hard

somber.oewn-00366341-s.tone: Gravity first and gloom only at its far end, which lets it carry dignity in a way *dismal* cannot.

sombre.oewn-00366341-s.label: negative

family.axis: cheer merely absent → gloom that presses hard

sombre.oewn-00366341-s.tone: The British spelling and the same word entirely: grave in weight, gloomy only when pushed to its limit.

seductive.oewn-02104548-a.label: neutral

family.axis: attraction offered openly → attraction that works as a cover for harm

seductive.oewn-02104548-a.tone: The plain name for the pull itself, and since the action drawn toward is one that is wanted, the word rates the force without rating where it leads, unlike *corrupting*.

alluring.oewn-02104760-s.label: positive

family.axis: attraction offered openly → attraction that works as a cover for harm

alluring.oewn-02104760-s.tone: Openly admiring - the attraction is a brightness that draws from a distance, with none of the spell-work *beguiling* implies.

beguiling.oewn-02104760-s.label: positive

family.axis: attraction offered openly → attraction that works as a cover for harm

beguiling.oewn-02104760-s.tone: The attraction works like a charm that holds you rather than a shine that catches you, so the hope it raises feels conjured where *alluring* simply glows.

enticing.oewn-02104760-s.label: positive

family.axis: attraction offered openly → attraction that works as a cover for harm

enticing.oewn-02104760-s.tone: The appeal arrives as an offer, pointing at a particular thing to be had, where *alluring* is a quality the thing merely possesses.

tempting.oewn-02104760-s.label: positive

family.axis: attraction offered openly → attraction that works as a cover for harm

tempting.oewn-02104760-s.tone: The desire it raises is one you may have to weigh against yourself, so the pull is felt as pressure rather than as the clean invitation of *enticing*.

corrupting.oewn-02105076-s.label: negative

family.axis: attraction offered openly → attraction that works as a cover for harm

corrupting.oewn-02105076-s.tone: Flatly condemning - it fixes on the ruin at the end of the pull rather than on the appeal that carries it there.

insidious.oewn-02105164-s.label: negative

family.axis: attraction offered openly → attraction that works as a cover for harm

insidious.oewn-02105164-s.tone: The whole warning sits in the pairing: the charm is real and is exactly what keeps the harm out of sight, where *corrupting* announces the damage plainly.

teasing.oewn-02105282-s.label: negative

family.axis: attraction offered openly → attraction that works as a cover for harm

teasing.oewn-02105282-s.tone: A light reproach - desire is raised deliberately and then left standing, so the fault named is the withholding rather than the attraction.

ashamed.oewn-00155165-a.label: neutral

family.axis: a passing inward discomfort → a public and settled loss of standing

ashamed.oewn-00155165-a.tone: The plain inward word for the state, wide enough to hold guilt and remorse as well as shame, and unlike *disgraced* it reports the feeling without pronouncing on the person's standing.

discredited.oewn-00155430-s.label: negative

family.axis: a passing inward discomfort → a public and settled loss of standing

discredited.oewn-00155430-s.tone: The shame lands as a withdrawal of belief, where *disgraced* takes away the standing itself.

disgraced.oewn-00155430-s.label: negative

family.axis: a passing inward discomfort → a public and settled loss of standing

disgraced.oewn-00155430-s.tone: Total and public, the shame settled into a condition rather than the passing sting of *embarrassed*.

dishonored.oewn-00155430-s.label: negative

family.axis: a passing inward discomfort → a public and settled loss of standing

dishonored.oewn-00155430-s.tone: The gravest and most formal of these, shame weighed against honour, where *shamed* is blunt and unceremonious.

shamed.oewn-00155430-s.label: negative

family.axis: a passing inward discomfort → a public and settled loss of standing

shamed.oewn-00155430-s.tone: Bare and unadorned: shame worked on someone from outside, where *ashamed* is shame felt from within.

embarrassed.oewn-00155537-s.label: negative

family.axis: a passing inward discomfort → a public and settled loss of standing

embarrassed.oewn-00155537-s.tone: The mildest and most survivable discomfort here, and the sting can be to pride as easily as to conscience.

humiliated.oewn-00155537-s.label: negative

family.axis: a passing inward discomfort → a public and settled loss of standing

humiliated.oewn-00155537-s.tone: Where *mortified* measures how sharp the discomfort is, this measures how far down it puts a person - shame or wounded pride, and no hand required to arrange the fall.

mortified.oewn-00155537-s.label: negative

family.axis: a passing inward discomfort → a public and settled loss of standing

mortified.oewn-00155537-s.tone: Hyperbolic in force: the discomfort is unbearable rather than merely awkward, and it can be pride that smarts.

hangdog.oewn-00155850-s.label: negative

family.axis: a passing inward discomfort → a public and settled loss of standing

hangdog.oewn-00155850-s.tone: Contemptuous and pictorial, the guilt showing as a cowering, beaten posture, and the word relishes saying so.

shamefaced.oewn-00155850-s.label: negative

family.axis: a passing inward discomfort → a public and settled loss of standing

shamefaced.oewn-00155850-s.tone: Puts the guilt exactly where it shows, on the face, without the whole cringing body of *hangdog*.

sheepish.oewn-00156104-s.label: negative

family.axis: a passing inward discomfort → a public and settled loss of standing

sheepish.oewn-00156104-s.tone: Faintly comic and forgiving, the shame it shows small enough to be smiled at, where *hangdog* invites contempt.

harmful.oewn-01163575-a.label: negative

family.axis: bare capacity to do damage → damage deliberately dealt to a person or a name

harmful.oewn-01163575-a.tone: States damage done or damage merely possible and stops there, flatter and cooler than *abusive* or *bruising*, which put a victim in the sentence.

abusive.oewn-01164128-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare capacity to do damage → damage deliberately dealt to a person or a name

abusive.oewn-01164128-s.tone: The heaviest word here, since the harm is maltreatment of a person in body or mind rather than the impersonal damage *harmful* allows.

bruising.oewn-01164424-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare capacity to do damage → damage deliberately dealt to a person or a name

bruising.oewn-01164424-s.tone: Lends the body's word to injury of the mind, so the damage arrives as an impact that leaves a mark rather than *harmful*'s abstract capacity.

deleterious.oewn-01164603-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare capacity to do damage → damage deliberately dealt to a person or a name

deleterious.oewn-01164603-s.tone: Formal and clinical, it registers damage to living things as a finding rather than a complaint, cooling what *hurtful* says plainly.

hurtful.oewn-01164603-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare capacity to do damage → damage deliberately dealt to a person or a name

hurtful.oewn-01164603-s.tone: The plain-spoken member of its trio, naming the same damage to living things in the everyday register that *deleterious* and *injurious* refuse.

injurious.oewn-01164603-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare capacity to do damage → damage deliberately dealt to a person or a name

injurious.oewn-01164603-s.tone: Formal like *deleterious* but weightier, treating the damage as an injury sustained rather than an effect observed.

calumniatory.oewn-01164777-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare capacity to do damage → damage deliberately dealt to a person or a name

calumniatory.oewn-01164777-s.tone: Elevated and heavy-tongued, it condemns the statement with a formality that makes the objection sound like a charge being laid.

calumnious.oewn-01164777-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare capacity to do damage → damage deliberately dealt to a person or a name

calumnious.oewn-01164777-s.tone: The trimmer form of *calumniatory* and no gentler for it, the statement still handled as malice dressed up as report.

defamatory.oewn-01164777-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare capacity to do damage → damage deliberately dealt to a person or a name

defamatory.oewn-01164777-s.tone: The plainest of these, condemning the statement squarely for the damage it does to a name and doing without *calumnious*'s elevation.

denigrative.oewn-01164777-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare capacity to do damage → damage deliberately dealt to a person or a name

denigrative.oewn-01164777-s.tone: Puts the weight on the blackening of the subject rather than on the untruth, and is the stiffest of the three denigrat- forms.

denigrating.oewn-01164777-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare capacity to do damage → damage deliberately dealt to a person or a name

denigrating.oewn-01164777-s.tone: The most immediate of its trio, catching the statement in the act of running someone down.

denigratory.oewn-01164777-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare capacity to do damage → damage deliberately dealt to a person or a name

denigratory.oewn-01164777-s.tone: Formal and dispositional, marking the statement as the belittling kind rather than *denigrating*'s act in progress.

libellous.oewn-01164777-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare capacity to do damage → damage deliberately dealt to a person or a name

libellous.oewn-01164777-s.tone: British spelling of *libelous*, and it carries the same weight, an accusation levelled at the statement rather than a description of it.

libelous.oewn-01164777-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare capacity to do damage → damage deliberately dealt to a person or a name

libelous.oewn-01164777-s.tone: Accusatory where *defamatory* is merely descriptive, charging the statement with the harm instead of noting that it does harm.

slanderous.oewn-01164777-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare capacity to do damage → damage deliberately dealt to a person or a name

slanderous.oewn-01164777-s.tone: The hottest of the set, hearing deliberate malice in the discrediting rather than *defamatory*'s cooler damage to reputation.

incomprehensible.oewn-00536071-a.label: negative

family.axis: a difficulty the reader can work at → understanding shut out entirely

incomprehensible.oewn-00536071-a.tone: States the difficulty and nothing more, with no hint of whether the fault lies in the style, the subject or the reader.

uncomprehensible.oewn-00536071-a.label: negative

family.axis: a difficulty the reader can work at → understanding shut out entirely

uncomprehensible.oewn-00536071-a.tone: Carries exactly the force of *incomprehensible* with a makeshift ring, the un- prefix doing plainer work than the in-.

obscure.oewn-00536470-s.label: negative

family.axis: a difficulty the reader can work at → understanding shut out entirely

obscure.oewn-00536470-s.tone: The same fault in the writing stated without *dark*'s metaphor: the style is at fault, and that is all it says.

enigmatic.oewn-00536744-s.label: positive

family.axis: a difficulty the reader can work at → understanding shut out entirely

enigmatic.oewn-00536744-s.tone: The one member that makes unclarity attractive, so that what is not clear reads as worth puzzling over rather than as a failing.

enigmatical.oewn-00536744-s.label: positive

family.axis: a difficulty the reader can work at → understanding shut out entirely

enigmatical.oewn-00536744-s.tone: Formal where *enigmatic* is quick, the longer ending adding stiffness without adding any mystery.

puzzling.oewn-00536744-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a difficulty the reader can work at → understanding shut out entirely

puzzling.oewn-00536744-s.tone: The mildest of the three, making the unclarity a snag to be worked at rather than *enigmatic*'s standing invitation.

unfathomable.oewn-00537047-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a difficulty the reader can work at → understanding shut out entirely

unfathomable.oewn-00537047-s.tone: Depth is the image, and it grants that understanding goes some way down and simply never reaches the bottom.

impenetrable.oewn-00537141-s.label: negative

family.axis: a difficulty the reader can work at → understanding shut out entirely

impenetrable.oewn-00537141-s.tone: Absolute and sealed: where *unfathomable* leaves partial understanding possible, this shuts it out altogether.

indecipherable.oewn-00537265-s.label: negative

family.axis: a difficulty the reader can work at → understanding shut out entirely

indecipherable.oewn-00537265-s.tone: Treats the thing as a code that will not yield, so the defeat is at the level of meaning rather than of style as in *obscure*.

lost.oewn-00537393-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a difficulty the reader can work at → understanding shut out entirely

lost.oewn-00537393-s.tone: Lays blame nowhere, reporting only that the thing failed to arrive, slipping past the senses or past the mind.

missed.oewn-00537393-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a difficulty the reader can work at → understanding shut out entirely

missed.oewn-00537393-s.tone: Hangs the same failure of catching on the one who did not catch it, where *lost* leaves the thing merely gone astray.

opaque.oewn-00537516-s.label: negative

family.axis: a difficulty the reader can work at → understanding shut out entirely

opaque.oewn-00537516-s.tone: A surface that shows nothing through it, stretching from hard going to flatly impossible.

unintelligible.oewn-00537516-s.label: negative

family.axis: a difficulty the reader can work at → understanding shut out entirely

unintelligible.oewn-00537516-s.tone: Blunt where *opaque* is figurative, and it reaches the same distance: from hard to make out to not to be made out at all.
